canonical_premises.statement: The community NGINX Ingress Controller will remain an operable and upgradeable platform component.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: The team accepts responsibility for controller upgrades, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

canonical_premises.statement: A later migration to Gateway API or another controller is possible but requires additional work.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: A later migration to Gateway API or another controller is possible but would require additional work.

canonical_premises.statement: The controller discovers new Ingress resources quickly enough for preview environments.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: It discovers new Ingress resources quickly enough for preview environments.
